title: Bo Nix: I don't know where the disconnect is offensively

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bo Nix: I don't know where the disconnect is offensively
sources.description: The point of playing football games is to win football games and the Broncos were able to do that against the Seahawks on Thursday night, but the result didn't shield their quarterback Bo Nix from some harsh criticism after the game.
